explication: AlertToast is a SwiftUI library for presenting configurable, self-dismissing alerts and toast-style messages. A host view supplies a presentation binding and an AlertToast configuration through `.toast`; the modifier overlays the configured presentation, with alert, HUD, and banner layouts and support for completion, error, image, text, and loading states. The sampled implementation shows loading presentations using ActivityIndicator. BlurView is included as a platform-specific visual effect component, but its use is not established by the excerpts. This map follows the README and sampled source; unsampled implementation details are omitted.
